mentions.name: Running Coach Plan Generator
mentions.description: A running coach style app that generates fully functional training plans. It grew out of the author's original idea of training for a trail race while living in a flat area with no easy access to natural climbing.
mentions.problem: Training for a trail race while living in a flat area with no easy access to natural climbing.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been plugging away at my running coach style app, powered by the original idea of training for a trail race while living in a flat area with no easy access to natural climbing that has evolved into a fully functional plan generator: https://runcoach.fly.dev
